text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hah, yah! Take thaaaaat!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's amazing, Biko-chan!
You're so fast it blew me away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Captivated by Biko Pegasus's spirited dribbling practice,
I couldn't help but stop in my tracks and watch.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! After all,
I've got an important match coming up...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A friend asked me to fill in as a sub.
And when you're a hero of justice,
you gotta give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
You use your small build to make
such quick and nimble turns!
And your speed catching up to the ball is like an arrow!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Your dribbling is going to be a huge asset to the team, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...? Heheh!
Thanks, Big-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, time to practice shooting next!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pierce through!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a sharp shot!
As expected of Biko-chan and your blazing speed!
Your shots are razor-sharp!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
If you polish this up,
it'll definitely become a special move shot!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A special move shot...! Hehe, sounds awesome!
All right, I'm definitely gonna master it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Gooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...O-Ooooh!
T-That one felt pretty good,
didn't it?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was even sharper than before!
Yup, that was even sharper than before!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Your natural speed got channeled right into it...
With that kind of power, it really is a special move shot!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I knew it?! Then in that case,
I've gotta give it a special move name and a signature pose!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I definitely wanna include Pegasus!
Shoot, or shot... Ah, but arrow
sounds cool too... Mmh, I can't decide!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Then why don't you try shouting them out while kicking?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Super Pegasus Arrow!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
A high-speed shot that pierces the goal like an arrow!
That's top-tier coolness right there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Pegasus Miracle Shining Shot!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
That feels like it could trigger a massive comeback! Wonderful!
How about putting all of them together?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds super powerful and cool!
Then next up, we need a finisher pose!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's done... Power, move name, and the signature pose!
The trinity of super special moves is born!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! Alright, for the final touch,
let's do a 1-on-1 showdown against me, Big-san!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Now then, can you get past me
and score a goal, Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ghk!
Big-senpai's putting out huge pressure!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Feels like wherever I kick, she'll stop it...!
But--

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Breaking through that is what makes it a special move!
Uwoooooooh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Pegasus Aurora Phoenix Arrow
Greatest Friendship Shoooooot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, curious about the results of Biko Pegasus's special training,
I headed over to the match she was playing in.
Samson Big was also there cheering her on.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, their defense is tight...!
I'll shake them off with my speed!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
She broke through the marking!
Here's your chance, Biko-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Pegasus Aurora Phoenix Arrow
Greatest Friendship Shoooooot!

text_block_list.name: Opposing Player
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Biko-chan scored!
The opposing players were totally frozen in place!
choice_data_list: Yeah! It packed quite the impact!
Yup! It had quite the impact!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sudden signature pose followed by screaming
an absurdly long move name left the players on the pitch
stunned and completely unable to react.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, total victory!
The special shot I came up with Big-senpai
worked like a charm!
choice_data_list: You two make quite the dynamic duo.
You two make quite the dynamic duo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, total victory!
The special shot I came up with Big-senpai
worked like a charm!
choice_data_list: You two make quite the dynamic duo.
You two make quite the dynamic duo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer!
Alright, riding this momentum, I'm gonna create
a second and third special shot too!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Always aiming higher and moving forward, just like a true hero.
I can't wait to see your new special shots!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Hearing you say that
makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, a dynamic duo, huh... It's true,
Big-senpai showered me with so much praise,
it really fired me up!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that makes Big-san super happy too♪
I'll keep on praising you lots and lots from now on!
